thread:
olivia-finance: Quick procurement question for the EDU pilot — can your billing produce one consolidated monthly invoice under a master PO that still breaks out per-school line items (org code + SKU) for our internal chargebacks? Also the pilot includes a 75,000 embedding-unit credit; finance wants unused credit to roll into the paid renewal if signed within 120 days. Is that doable? cc @ajay-procurement @ben-eng @sara-legal

vendor-billing: Yes to consolidated invoice + per-org lines. We can do credit rollover as a contract addendum for a set window. Quick clarifiers: 1) currency? 2) need VAT/GST line items? 3) prefer credit applied pre-discount or shown as negative line?

ajay-procurement: USD invoices. VAT fields required for EU schools. Rollover should apply pre-discount and count toward commit bands if possible. We'll need your W9/TIN for PO and any VAT registration numbers.

ben-eng: CSV schema we need for ingestion: `date, invoice_id, org_id, org_name, project_code, sku, meter_type, usage_units, unit_price, discount, vat_amount, line_total, hashed_request_id`. Please include meter_type (embedding/generation) and a hashed request id for dispute audits.

sara-legal: Legal asks: DPA with subprocessors, export-control clause for non-US institutions, confirmation no model weights/training data are transferred, and a sample SOW + termination/credit dispute SLA. We'll need any addendum for rollover in writing before applying credits.

vendor-billing: We'll send sample consolidated invoice PDF, sample CSV layout, DPA draft, sample SOW, and W9/TIN by EOD Wed. Default credit expiry is 90 days; for this pilot we can do 120 days rollover and apply it pre-discount. We'll also include a negative-line backup entry for audit trail.

procure-bot: Noted — adding billing_ops@vendor to thread. Reminder: PO creation lead time ~7 business days after paperwork. Vendor to provide requested docs to avoid PO delays.

olivia-finance: Preference confirmed: apply credit pre-discount but also provide negative-line on the invoice for audit. If vendor confirms docs by EOD Wed procurement will draft PO next week. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
